jonathan.procure: Quick flag — VendorAtlas just pinged about reallocating ~18% of our Q3 H100 allocation to a different forwarder. They want to amend the commitment (reduce 10 units / month) and add a restocking fee on returns. Thoughts?

maria.ops: @jonathan.procure do we have the contract clause that allows them to change forwarder or allocations mid-quarter? I thought allocations were fixed for committed capacity. :thinking_face:

jonathan.procure: Contract has a narrow force-majeure carveout but nothing about forwarder swaps. Their email references container shortages + customs delays.

anya-logistics: If they switch forwarder it might change ETA windows and customs HS handling — could trigger extra broker fees and slowdown for EU pools. We need lead times per SKU.

vendor-rep: VendorAtlas here — to be clear: we're not trying to reduce total units for Redwood, just reallocate which shipments go with which forwarder to keep lead times. We're proposing pause of 10 units/mo from ForwarderA and shift them to ForwarderC for July-Aug. No change to total Q3 quantity. Also proposing a 3% restock fee on DOA returns processed outside our preferred depots.

paul-supply: The 3% restock on DOA is new and not in SOW. That's a material change. We reject unless they offset with freight credit or faster ETA.

leo-qa: On DOA/RMA: any change to depot routing affects our RMA SLA. We run burn/acceptance at EU depots; moving depots could add 7-10 days to RMAs and block replacements. Not acceptable for Dedicated customers with SLA.

maria.ops: Also need clarity on serial manifest flow. If forwarder swap changes AWBs, we'll need new manifests for inventory reconciliation — that historically caused 1-2 day holds at customs.

vendor-rep: Understood. Proposal: we cover customs brokerage surcharge up to $750 per container and guarantee depot routing won't change for units bound to EU Dedicated pools. Restock fee only applies to units returned without OEM seal or missing paperwork (rare).

jonathan.procure: Can you put that in writing? Also confirm which depot list you guarantee.

vendor-rep: Sending written amendment in 24h with depot list attached. Also attaching provisional AWB ranges per forwarder in the thread.

shipment-bot: AWB update from VendorAtlas: AWB 1Z999AA -> ForwarderC, expected arrival FRA 2024-07-12 06:00Z.

anya-logistics: FRA arrival ok but watch for customs HS reclassification we saw last month (H100 variant flagged). If that repeats, we might need pre-clear paperwork which adds hold.

paul-supply: Also pricing note — VendorAtlas asked to increase unit price by 4% due to freight inflation. If they keep allocation commitment, we can negotiate a smaller uplift or a freight pass-through. Jonathan, can you push back?

jonathan.procure: I'll push back and propose a tiered uplift: 2% for committed volumes, 5% for spot/top-ups. Also request explicit RMA playbook: depot list, transit insurance (carrier + vendor liability), SLA for replacement due to DOA, and claim dispute timeline.

leo-qa: Add requirement: replacement units must be pre-staged in EU pool within 10 business days for SLA customers, otherwise fallback to configured fallback model (smaller instance) until replacement arrives.

maria.ops: Okay — next steps: Jonathan to get the written amendment, Anya to validate depot list and customs notes, Leo to draft RMA SLA clause, Paul to run cost impact vs committed VCPU pricing. We'll reconvene after amendment.

jonathan.procure: Received draft amendment PDF from VendorAtlas (attached). Key lines: 'Vendor may substitute forwarder where necessary; vendor will endeavor to notify buyer 72 hours in advance; restock fee applies to returns not processed through vendor-certified depots.'

anya-logistics: That 'endeavor to notify' is weak. We need mandatory notification + 7-day lead to allow manifest updates. Please ask for contract language: 'vendor shall notify buyer no less than 7 calendar days prior to any forwarder substitution that impacts AWB ranges or depot routing.'

vendor-rep: We can update to 72 -> 7 days for allocations >5 units. For smaller swaps we keep 72h. Is that workable?

maria.ops: Acceptable if it's in writing and we get explicit AWB and depot mapping before shipment. Also demand a single point of contact for escalations.

paul-supply: One more ask: if they insist on 3% restock for non-OEM sealed returns, we want a cap (max $2k / month) or a waiver for first two incidents.

vendor-rep: We'll agree to waiver for first two incidents and cap thereafter at $2k/month. Adding to amendment.

jonathan.procure: Great. I'll coordinate legal review. Once signed, Anya please confirm we can update console routing policies so incoming shipments align with Dedicated pool routing.

anya-logistics: Will do. I'll also create a pre-clear checklist for FRA customs and send to vendor so paperwork is consistent.

leo-qa: And I'll add the RMA fallback to the SLA doc and run a quick simulation for worst-case replacement latency.

maria.ops: Thanks everyone. Portal note: I'll add a short Ops FYI in #eng-infra once amendment signed. :white_check_mark:
